senses.en_definition: A mark, footprint, or other trace left by something.
An effect or result, whether beneficial or harmful, of an event, action, or situation.
An impression on someone's thoughts, attitudes, or feelings caused by something seen, heard, or read.

messages.en: That film really stayed with me. I still think about the bit where his kid waits at the door.
Same here. I thought it was just going to be an ordinary story, and we both ended up crying.
Right? I called my mum as soon as I got home.

senses.en_definition: The state of being safe, secure, and free from danger, harm, or threats.

messages.en: Put your seat belt on first. We're about to set off.
Hang on, my bag's caught on something. There, it's on. Let's go!
I read the whole report at home earlier.
That's good. I've only read the summary. I want to look at the costs section next.
If we've got time this weekend, let's drop by Cikgu Salmah's place.
Sure, I'd love to come along. Let's check with her first, though, in case she's got something on.
